title: Rekordbox Bass Notes

label: DJ workflow tool
problem: DJs looking for tracks with strong low-end energy need information they can use in their existing music-library workflow. This tool connects bass analysis to Rekordbox.
role: I built a tool that profiles bass characteristics and writes the results directly into the Rekordbox database.

decisions.purpose: Help DJs identify tracks with strong low-end energy.

decisions.decision: Results written into the Rekordbox database
decisions.purpose: Put the analysis into the existing DJ workflow.

delivered: A bass-profiling tool with direct Rekordbox database integration.

title: Dancefloor Bass Analyzer
description: A desktop app for exploring the low-frequency characteristics of a DJ’s music library, built with React and Rust.
label: Desktop app / in development
problem: A DJ exploring a music library needs a way to inspect the low-frequency character of tracks. This project focuses on that exploration in a desktop interface.
role: I’m developing the desktop app with React and Rust. Its focus is library exploration and track inspection, distinct from the direct Rekordbox database integration of Bass Notes.

decisions.decision: A desktop interface built with React and Rust
decisions.purpose: Bring music-library exploration into a dedicated application.
Help DJs explore the low-frequency characteristics of individual tracks.

delivered: An in-development desktop application. A downloadable production release is not being offered here.
planned: Continue developing and documenting local processing, track inspection, adjustable profiles, and responsive analysis. Exact feature readiness still needs confirmation.
